title: Prompted Now a haiku about the first frost
Prompted Draft a haiku about autumn

safeHtmlItem.html:
Maple leaves let go—
the river carries October
past the empty dock.
Denver sits at about 1,600 m, so water boils near 95°C rather than 100°C.

title: Prompted What is the boiling point of water at altitude?

safeHtmlItem.html:
It drops as pressure falls:

  • Sea level: 100°C
  • 2,000 m: about 93°C
